integrity: All formulas are derived for the stated observable and sampling law. Finite numerical experiments are corroborative, not infinite proofs; originality is best-knowledge and external validation is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only iid uniform sites on the unit two-sphere; interface-point law is annealed and length weighted, not quenched. The 1971 Miles paper was not fully accessible, so historical priority is not definitively settled. No variance of total length or edge-length distribution is asserted.
title: The annealed metric law of spherical Voronoi interfaces
